# Farah & Farah

> > Established personal injury law firm serving Florida and Georgia with specialized legal representation across accident claims, workers' compensation, and disability cases.

Farah & Farah has been providing personal injury legal services since 1979, with major offices in Jacksonville and Orlando, Florida. The firm specializes in motor vehicle accidents, premises liability, workers' compensation, Social Security Disability, and medical malpractice claims across multiple jurisdictions.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Car Accident Claims
- Workers' Compensation
- Medical Malpractice
- Social Security Disability (SSDI)
- Truck Accidents
- Motorcycle Accidents
- Pedestrian Accidents
- Slip and Fall Claims
- Free Consultation
- Jacksonville, FL
- Orlando, FL
- Florida Law
- Insurance Claims
- Injury Compensation
